name: Chains of Hematus
summary: The Chains of Hematus are the bindings taken from the black drake Hematus in Lethlor Ravine. They are sought alongside Blacklash’s bindings after the Seal of the Earth is broken.

sections.title: A Broken Seal
sections.body: In Lethlor Ravine, the Chains of Hematus are returned after Hematus is freed from the Seal of the Earth. Three runestones taken from the ravine’s pillars unlock that seal. Garek or Gorn seeks the chains alongside Blacklash’s bindings, once the two black drakes have been slain.

faq.q: What are the Chains of Hematus?
faq.answer: The Chains of Hematus are bindings taken from the black drake Hematus in Lethlor Ravine.

faq.q: Where do I find the Chains of Hematus?
faq.answer: Hematus in Lethlor Ravine, in the Badlands, bears the Chains of Hematus.
Garek or Gorn asks for the Chains of Hematus alongside Blacklash’s bindings after the drakes are slain.
The runestones from the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst are placed in the Seal of the Earth, freeing Hematus and Blacklash.
Garek or Gorn seeks the Chains of Hematus, depending on who sent you to Lethlor Ravine.
